trades.scope_description: Host, presenter, agenda/run-of-show, announcements, audience interaction.
Mocktails and beverage service; alcohol only where lawful, licensed and appropriate.
Bridal/event makeup, hair styling and touch-ups.
Celebration cakes, dessert tables and serving coordination.
Menu planning, food preparation/service, dietary needs and meal logistics.
Theme styling, flowers, backdrop, entrance, table styling, props.
DJ, playlist, dance-floor music and music cues.
Master schedule, vendor coordination, load-in/out, contingency and event-day coordination.
Tables, chairs, staging accessories, counters and event equipment.
Stage, ambient, architectural, decorative and effect lighting.
Consumables, props, event materials and last-mile supplies.
Return gifts, guest favours, giveaways, packaging and distribution.
Registration, ushering, guest welcome, help desk, VIP/elder assistance.
Invitations, RSVP collateral, menus, badges and printed materials.
Musicians, performers, dancers and specialty acts.
Manual handling, setup assistance, dismantling and packing.
Medium/large cargo movement for bulky event goods.
Henna application for relevant wedding/festival events.
Small cargo runs and local delivery/pickup.
Guest shuttles, group transport and airport/station transfers.
Event photography, portraits, stage moments and edited gallery.
Generator/backup power, fans, cooling and power contingency.
Priest/ritual officiant and ceremony-specific requirements.
First aid, safety provisions, accessibility and facilities planning.
Access control, crowd security, backstage/VIP protection.
PA, microphones, speakers, mixers, screens/projectors and technical operation.
Temporary canopy/pandal, furniture and outdoor shelter.
Event goods/transport coordination; clarify passenger vs cargo need.
Wedding trousseau, ceremonial trays, gift packing and presentation.
Guest vehicle reception, parking flow and key management.
Venue sourcing/booking, capacity, access, facilities, permissions and site readiness.
Event video capture, highlights and livestream capture where agreed.
Temporary storage, inventory, holding and retrieval of event materials.
Wedding-specific planning, ceremony sequencing, vendor and family coordination.
